description: Remove one permission from a file: that person, group, domain or link loses access. Inherited shared-drive access cannot be removed here. It changes who can open the file: do it only on the user's explicit go for this file and these people.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

file_id.description: The file's id, or its URL.

name: remove_permission
title: Remove someone's access
